procurement.suppliersSubtitle: Fabric mills, factories and wholesalers you buy from.

procurement.cancelPoConfirm: Cancel this order? Anything already received stays in stock.
procurement.draftHint: Mark the order as sent once it's placed with the supplier — you can receive goods after that.
procurement.receiveHint: Enter what actually arrived. Stock is added to the receiving location and the cost price is updated per Settings → inventory.

stockOps.transfersSubtitle: Move stock between warehouses and shops.
stockOps.needTwoLocations: You need at least two active stock locations.
stockOps.cancelTransferConfirm: Cancel this transfer? Stock already dispatched goes back to the source.
stockOps.dispatchHint: Dispatching removes the units from the source location (they must be available, not reserved for orders).
stockOps.receiveTransferHint: Enter what actually arrived; any shortfall is recorded on the transfer.
stockOps.stockTakesSubtitle: Count a location, review the variance, then apply it.
stockOps.stockTakeStartHint: Starting a count records each variant's current on-hand. Sales during the count are kept — only the counted difference is applied.
stockOps.cancelTakeConfirm: Cancel this stock take? Counts are discarded.
stockOps.applyConfirm: Apply the count? {lines} line(s) will be adjusted.
stockOps.zeroUncountedConfirm: {lines} line(s) were not counted. Press OK to treat them as zero (full count) or Cancel to leave them unchanged.
stockOps.uncostedNote: {lines} line(s) with a variance have no cost price, so they're not in the value.

analysis.title: Inventory analysis
analysis.subtitle: Which sizes to buy, and what stock isn't moving.
analysis.sizeCurveHint: Compares the share of sales per size with the share of stock per size. Enter a buy quantity to split a new order toward what sells.
analysis.curveMeta: Last {days} days · {sold} sold · {onHand} on hand · {products} product(s)
analysis.legend: Coloured bar = share of sales, grey bar = share of stock. A negative gap means that size is under-stocked for its demand.
analysis.applyMarkdownsConfirm: Create price schedules for {count} variant(s), starting now?
analysis.markdownsCreated: {count} price schedule(s) created — see Price schedules to adjust or cancel.
analysis.noDeadStock: Nothing has gone unsold that long.

finance.codSubtitle: Match courier payouts to delivered parcels and catch short payments.
finance.uploadHint: CSV or Excel export from the courier's merchant panel. Amounts in taka.
finance.rowsFound: {count} row(s) found — check the columns below.
finance.linkShipmentPrompt: Shipment ID to match this line to (blank to unlink):
finance.confirmSettlementConfirm: Confirm this settlement? {flagged} flagged line(s) — unmatched and duplicate lines won't be posted.
finance.confirmHint: Confirming marks each matched parcel as settled and records the courier's charge as its actual delivery cost.
finance.gatewaySubtitle: Record bKash, Nagad and SSLCommerz payouts; the variance compares them with our own successful payments.
finance.invalidAmount: Enter amounts in taka, e.g. 12500 or 12500.50
finance.profitSubtitle: Revenue minus product cost, courier charges and gateway fees — per day or per order.
finance.profitNoteScope: Counts orders placed in the range that reached a final delivery outcome. Failed deliveries count their courier cost as a loss.
finance.profitNoteCourier: {count} order(s) have no actual courier charge yet — estimated from the shipping fee until a COD settlement is confirmed.
finance.profitNoteUncosted: {count} unit(s) sold have no cost price, so product cost is understated.
finance.profitNoteGatewayRecorded: Gateway fees from recorded settlements for: {methods}; others estimated.
finance.profitNoteGatewayEstimated: Gateway fees are estimated from Settings → finance until settlements are recorded.
finance.profitNoteAds: Ad spend will be included once ad-spend import is available.
finance.noProfitData: No orders with a final outcome in this range.

scheduledReports.subtitle: Reports emailed automatically every day, week (Saturday) or month (1st).
scheduledReports.name: Name

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.subtitle: Unusual changes in orders, revenue, cancellations and rejections, checked every morning.

loyalty.subtitle: Points on delivered orders, redeemable at checkout, with tiers by lifetime spend.
loyalty.sweepsDone: Points earned, released, expired and refunded where due.
loyalty.programOff: The loyalty program is off. Turn it on in Settings → loyalty.
loyalty.tiersHelp: Customers move to the highest tier whose minimum lifetime spend they have reached. The multiplier boosts points earned.

journeys.empty: No journeys yet — add the starter set to begin.

journeys.typeHelp_birthday: Starts on the customer's birthday (from their account profile) at the send hour, Dhaka time.
journeys.respectConsent: Only send to customers who opted in to marketing on that channel

broadcasts.title: Broadcasts
broadcasts.subtitle: Send one message to a segment by SMS, WhatsApp, email or push — only to customers who opted in.
broadcasts.name: Name

adSpend.imported: Imported {imported} campaign-days from {rows} rows ({errors} rows skipped).

adSpend.empty: No spend or paid orders in this period.
adSpend.attributionHelp: Orders match a platform by utm_source (Settings → marketing) and a campaign by utm_campaign = campaign name or ID.

calendar.title: Promo calendar
calendar.subtitle: Discounts, flash sales, banners, popups, price changes, broadcasts and scheduled pages in one view.

rfm.help: Recency, frequency and monetary scores (1–5) compare each customer with the rest of your store. Rule fields: rfmSegment, rfmRecency, rfmFrequency, rfmMonetary.

ai.title: AI content
ai.subtitle: Which provider and model each feature uses, its prompt, monthly budgets, and what it has cost.
ai.disabled: AI assistance is off. Turn it on in Settings → ai.
ai.openIntegrations: Add Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini or the mock in Integrations → ai.
ai.globalSpend: This month: {spent} across {calls} calls · store budget {budget}.
ai.paramsHelp: Effort applies to Claude; temperature to OpenAI and Gemini (current Claude models don't accept it). Budgets are a hard stop; staff with AI permission are alerted at the threshold in Settings → ai.
ai.costNote: Costs are estimates from the per-million-token prices set on each provider in Integrations.

quality.title: Product quality
quality.subtitle: What each product is missing, worst first. Click an issue to filter.

seo.brokenLinksHelp: Checks links in pages, blog posts, menus, banners, popups, product and category descriptions and redirects. External links are checked only when enabled in Settings → seo.

personalization.subtitle: Recommendations from your order and browsing data, and search by photo.

personalization.disabled: Recommendations are switched off in Settings → personalization — the storefront shows only hand-picked related products.
personalization.visualSearchHelp: The first 3 photos of every active product are indexed in the background (colour and shape — no AI cost). With AI vision on, garment type and pattern improve matches.
personalization.reindexConfirm: Clear the photo index and rebuild it from scratch? Search by photo works on whatever is indexed while it rebuilds.
personalization.reindexed: Index cleared ({count} images) — rebuilding in the background.

personalization.settingsHint: Switches, AI use and limits are in

experiments.title: A/B tests
experiments.subtitle: Show different versions of a block, announcement bar or offer to different visitors and see which one sells more.
experiments.name: Name
experiments.kindHelp_block: A block on a published page, e.g. the home page hero or a banner.
experiments.kindHelp_announcement: The text and link of an announcement bar.
experiments.kindHelp_offer: Each variant's visitors get a different discount (or none). Discounts in a running test apply only to their own variant.
experiments.blockPropsHelp: Starts as a copy of the block's current settings — change only what you're testing. Checked against the block type when you save.
experiments.startedNotice: Test started — visitors are being split now.
experiments.pausedNotice: Paused — everyone sees the control until you resume.
experiments.deleteConfirm: Delete this test and its data?
experiments.verdict_collecting: Still collecting data — every variant needs at least {min} visitors before a result is called.
experiments.verdict_no_difference: No variant is clearly better yet at {confidence}% confidence. Keep it running or stop it — the difference may be too small to matter.
experiments.verdict_control_better: The control is doing better than every variant at {confidence}% confidence.
experiments.visitorsNeeded: To detect a 10% improvement on the control's rate you need about {count} visitors per variant.
experiments.apply_block: Copy the winner into the page draft
experiments.apply_announcement: Put the winner's text on the bar
experiments.apply_offer: Switch off the other variants' discounts
experiments.completeConfirm: End this test? Everyone will see the same version again.
experiments.offerCompleteWarning: When an offer test ends, all its discounts apply to everyone unless they're switched off — keep "Switch off the other variants' discounts" ticked unless you mean that.
experiments.lockedHelp: This test has started: what's tested can't change any more (it would mix two tests in one result). You can rename it and raise its traffic.
experiments.hypothesisPlaceholder: e.g. A free-delivery message will get more orders than 10% off.
experiments.publishedOnly: Only blocks on the published version of the page.
experiments.controlHelp: The control is the current version, exactly as published.

materials.title: Materials & BOM

materials.notUsed: Not used in any bill of materials yet.

materials.variantCostsHint: For comparison only — the variant cost price used in profit reports is set by receiving stock, not by the BOM.

apiKeys.name: Name
apiKeys.usage: Send the key as an Authorization: Bearer header to /api/v1/public/v1/products, /inventory or /orders. The public API must be switched on under Settings → Platform.
apiKeys.createdHint: Copy it now — for security it is shown only once and cannot be retrieved later.
apiKeys.revokeConfirm: Revoke the key {name}? Anything using it will stop working immediately.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.subtitle: Get a signed HTTPS call to your own system whenever an order changes.
webhooks.name: Name
webhooks.verifyHint: Each call carries X-Webhook-Id, X-Webhook-Event and X-Webhook-Signature (t=timestamp,v1=HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp.body using the signing secret). Delivery is at least once, so de-duplicate on the id. Webhooks must be switched on under Settings → Platform.
webhooks.secretHint: Copy it now — it is shown only once. Use it to verify the signature on every call.
webhooks.rotateConfirm: Replace the signing secret for {name}? The old secret stops working immediately.
webhooks.deleteConfirm: Delete the endpoint {name} and its delivery history?

configBundle.title: Config bundle
configBundle.subtitle: Export this store's setup — settings, texts, templates, categories, menus and pages — and import it into a new deployment to launch another brand quickly.
configBundle.exportHint: Secrets, orders, customers, stock and media files are never included. Pages and menus may refer to images or products that must be re-picked on the new store.
configBundle.emptyBundle: This file has no data in it.
configBundle.notJson: This is not a valid bundle file.
configBundle.publishPages: Publish pages that were published in the bundle (otherwise new pages arrive as drafts)
configBundle.applyConfirm: Apply the import? {created} item(s) will be created and {updated} updated. Nothing is deleted.
configBundle.previewBanner: Preview only — nothing has been changed yet.
